# badger

```go
import "github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/stores/badger"
```

Package badger is the BadgerDB state\-store backend for blkit: a durable, embedded store keeping each run's ProcessState in local files, tuned for write throughput. See specs/stores/badger\-state\-store.spec.md.

<a name="New"></a>
### func [New](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L33>)

```go
func New(cfg Config) *Store
```

New opens (creating if needed) the Badger store. Following the blkit constructor convention it panics on an invalid config or an unopenable store. The store runs with SyncWrites off for throughput; Flush provides the durability barrier via DB.Sync.

<a name="Store.Close"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Close](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L397>)

```go
func (s *Store) Close() error
```

Close releases the sequence lease and closes the store.

<a name="Store.Config"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Config](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L392>)

```go
func (s *Store) Config() (map[string]string, error)
```

Config returns an error: a Badger store is local to one process on one machine and cannot be shared.

<a name="Store.CurrentVersion"></a>
### func (\*Store) [CurrentVersion](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L271>)

```go
func (s *Store) CurrentVersion(runID string) (*bl.CurrentVersion, error)
```

CurrentVersion folds the run's value records into the latest committed value per (task, field); iteration order is replay order. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.Flush"></a>
### func (\*Store) [Flush](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L236>)

```go
func (s *Store) Flush(runID string) error
```

Flush syncs Badger's WAL to disk — the durability barrier that pairs with running SyncWrites off.

<a name="Store.FullHistory"></a>
### func (\*Store) [FullHistory](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L311>)

```go
func (s *Store) FullHistory(runID string) (*bl.FullHistory, error)
```

FullHistory iterates the v| and h| prefixes in key (= replay) order. Returns (nil, nil) for an unknown run.

<a name="Store.WriteBatch"></a>
### func (\*Store) [WriteBatch](<https://github.com/friendly-business-machines/blkit/blob/main/stores/badger/store.go#L118>)

```go
func (s *Store) WriteBatch(ops []bl.WriteOp) error
```

WriteBatch applies the ops in a single Badger transaction, so a task's outputs land together.
